full_judgment: 3. Trial court decreed the suit and directed that the plaintiff do get khas possession of the suit premises by evicting defendant Nos. 1 and 2 therefrom. Defendant No. 2 moved the High Court Division under section 25 of the Small Causes Courts Act and contended, inter alia, that as she was not a tenant under the Premises Rent Control Ordinance, 1963 present suit (or eviction was not maintainable against her.
